segments.on_screen_text:
FINDING COMFORT
soft summer days on the island
segments.description: A montage showcasing various highlights of a summer trip to an island with text overlay.
Scenes of taking a bus, boarding a ferry, eating food, and enjoying the view on the boat.
Exploring Sidney, walking around local shops, stopping at the water, and visiting a farm market cafe.

segments.on_screen_text: by late afternoon we made our way into victoria
segments.description: Travelling into Victoria, walking through Market Square and Chinatown, and getting ramen for dinner.

segments.on_screen_text: as the sun began to set the streets turned to gold
segments.description: Golden hour sunset shots around the city, stopping at an ice cream shop.

segments.on_screen_text: the next day was slower softer
segments.description: Next day activities: eating fish and chips at Fisherman's Wharf, coffee shop, and browsing boutique gift stores.
Ferry ride back during sunset with summary thoughts text overlay.

hook.opening_visual: Ferry deck at sunset with seated passengers.
hook.notes: Aesthetic montage clip setting the gentle, atmospheric tone of the vlog.
